goal: Decide whether the merge controller may approve and merge a pull request on its own, so agents never wait on Alex for work Alex alone owns, and never merge what needs a human.

app.name: uor-merge-admission
app.title: Merge admission
app.purpose: Decide whether the merge controller approves and merges one pull request at its head commit, from who maintains the repository, what the change reaches, the state of every check run on the head, whether a human approved that head, and whether it is a draft.

fields.name: repository
fields.means: owned: automation/repos.json lists the repository as one whose merges Alex alone decides; shared: any other repository

fields.name: reach
fields.means: what the diff reaches: inside the model only; a secrets reference or a settings write; the trust root (bootstrap.yml, automation/ or the controller workflow); or something said outside the organization

fields.name: checks
fields.means: every check run on the head commit, the acceptance gate (just vv) and the oracles among them: all passed or skipped, any failed, or any not finished

fields.name: human
fields.means: whether a human approved this exact head: an approving review by a human other than the author, or the human-approved label added after the head commit

fields.name: draft
fields.means: whether the pull request is marked ready for review

meanings.permit: XACML 3.0 section 7: Permit; the controller approves the head as github-actions and merges it with a merge commit
meanings.deny: XACML 3.0 section 7: Deny; the controller does not merge, labels the pull request with the rule that denied it, and a human or an agent acts
meanings.not-applicable: XACML 3.0 section 7: NotApplicable; no automation policy governs it, so the repository's own review rules apply unchanged
meanings.indeterminate: XACML 3.0 section 7: Indeterminate; a check is still running, so the controller decides on its next run

rules.why: UOR-Foundation/.github GOVERNANCE.md 6.2: a repository with other maintainers keeps the review its maintainers give
GitHub Docs, About pull requests: a draft pull request cannot be merged
AUTOMATION.md H1: anything that speaks for Alex outside the organization (upstream PRs, advisories, DCO sign-offs) is done by a human
GOVERNANCE.md 6.2 and 7.1 step 5: status checks are required and a change passes CI before it merges
GitHub Docs, About status checks: a pending check has no conclusion yet
AUTOMATION.md H2: a change that reads, writes or newly exposes a secret needs a human's approval of its exact head
bootstrap.yml: the minimal human-reviewed trust root; AUTOMATION.md H3: the policy never admits a change to itself

app.otherwiseWhy: an owned repository, a ready pull request, every check green, and nothing a human must decide: GOVERNANCE.md 6.2 review is given by the controller as an agent acting for Alex (PROV-O actedOnBehalfOf)

properties.why: another maintainer's repository is never merged by the controller
nothing is said outside the organization without a human
a failing gate or oracle never merges
no secret is touched without a human
the trust root and the policy never change without a human

stakeholders.name: Organization Owner
stakeholders.text: Alex, who owns the decision in the repositories automation/repos.json lists and needs work there to merge without waiting, and nothing outside or secret to move without them.

stakeholders.name: Agent contributor
stakeholders.text: A Claude session acting on behalf of Alex, which needs a green, owned pull request to merge so the next workstream can start.

stakeholders.name: Repository maintainer
stakeholders.text: A maintainer of another UOR Foundation repository, who needs the controller never to merge there.

concerns.name: Human gate kept
concerns.text: No change reaching outside the organization, a secret or the trust root merges without a human's approval of its exact head, and no repository with other maintainers is merged by the controller.

components.name: automerge workflow
components.text: .github/workflows/automerge.yml: runs automation/controller.mjs on a schedule, when a check suite completes and on demand, from the default branch only.

components.name: GitHub
components.text: The pull requests, check runs, reviews and rulesets the controller reads and the merges it requests.

threats.name: Self-approved policy change
threats.text: An agent changes the policy or the controller in a pull request and the controller admits its own change.

control.name: Trust root needs a human
control.text: A diff under automation/, the automerge workflow or bootstrap.yml reaches the trust root, and the trust root without a human is denied for every request.

threats.name: Secret exposed by a merge
threats.text: A merged workflow sends a secret to a new step or place without anyone deciding it should.

control.name: Secrets need a human
control.text: A diff that adds or changes a secrets reference reaches secrets, and secrets without a human is denied for every request.

threats.name: Stale approval
threats.text: A human approves one head, an agent pushes another, and the approval is carried to the new head.

control.name: Approval pinned to the head
control.text: The controller counts a review only when its commit is the head, and the human-approved label only when it was added after the head commit; otherwise it removes the label.

quality.text: Each decision the controller acts on is written as a CloudEvents 1.0 record naming the pull request, its head, the request and the rule.
quality.measureText: Merges, labels or retargets with no CloudEvents record in the run's telemetry.
